title: Chapter 518
paragraphs: Chapter 518
Episode 142: Negotiations (4)

Zephyrin had the appearance of a bird-human often described in novels. Overall, he looked like a human, but his entire body, except for his face, was covered in black feathers, and he had wings on his arms.
And he flew very fast. He appeared as a dot and in no time, he was close enough to recognize.
"Huh, what's with that crow-looking human? Is it a surprise disguise show my son-in-law prepared for me?"
"That's Zephyrin, a demon dragon. It seems she has some business with me."
"Another woman, huh? Our son-in-law is quite popular."
Naturally, Zephyrin didn't seem very friendly.

Not only had he been tricked by Jin in the Sota Desert, but his plan to take Joshua hostage had also failed, and he had to overexert his power again due to the battle at the end and the damage from the volcano, so he was quite angry.
'Somehow, it feels cold.'
At any other time, he would have been somewhat tense, but Jin looked around calmly at his colleagues on both sides.
He couldn't help but smile.
"That, that thing. Zephyrin. Is that Zephyrin!?"
"Zephyrin, you say? That damned...!"
"We were so good to her!"
The eyes of the Black King's members who were on external guard duty sharpened like knives.
"Prepare to load the Black King Cannon No.1, it's the leader's enemy!"
"Open all the gates, including the Black King Cannon No.1, we will avenge our leader!"
"Our leader's sacrifice was not in vain!"
The Black King members spoke as if Valkas had died back then. Whether it was to heighten their anger or someone had used the term enemy, creating a strange flow, it was unclear.
The cannons were aimed.
The Black King members on the central watchtower were signaling. They were ready to shoot that damned thing and were asking for an immediate order.
"Um, my lord. Make a decision."
"Let's test our defense capabilities for once."
As Valkas raised his hand, the members on the watchtower nodded their heads.
Clang! Creaking, clatter-!
At the same time, the defensive equipment installed by the Black King's group began to reveal itself all around the walls of Tikan.
The change was as smooth as gears meshing together and rotating.
Gunports opened all over the outer walls, revealing the barrels, and the artifacts installed on nearby reefs spread out anti-air shields simultaneously.
Harpoons for suppression and pressure poured out from all sides. There were artifacts that fired nets and more than forty giant bows that several members pulled the strings of together.
Many other defensive equipment aimed at Zephyrin as well.
'I've heard that the fortification has begun, but was it this much? Ha, besides, I should be greeted politely, but I'm treated like this... I'm speechless, Jin Kyung!'
Begin firing!
As the captains shouted, the sky was instantly filled with red from cannonballs, flames, arrows, hooks, and nets.
A dragon of ordinary level would have already met its end at this point, but Zephyrin showed its ability to dodge skillfully in every direction.
'...This is quite intense.'
Zephyrin experienced its first shock in that scene.
Under normal circumstances, it would have just sneered at the situation. However, now it couldn't use the power of the commander.
"Fire the Black King Cannon!"
"Fire!"
As soon as it was judged that a clear shot was made, the Black King Cannon No. 1 spewed fire.
Boom-!
A heavy and refreshing explosion, as if something blocked was being pierced, echoed after the cannonball had already brushed past Zephyrin's cheek and shoulder.
'Uh, what just...?'
Had it been hit directly in its current weakened state, it would have either died or suffered damage close to death.
With such a strong intuition, Zephyrin had no choice but to block the next Black King Cannon No. 1, which was flying at an unavoidable angle.
It had to draw on the commander's power (at that moment, the lying commander coughed up blood and a crisis arose for Kinzelo).
"That's quite impressive!"
The power of the Black King Cannon No. 1 was at an extraordinary level.
"It was our Black King Squad's pride."
"Now that we know its rough performance, please guide Zephyrin to land on our side."
As Valkas relayed Jin's order, the nature of the shooting changed to suppression and guidance.
Afterwards, Zephyrin spent about 5 minutes rolling in the sky before landing in the front yard of the mansion, looking quite battered.
"Ha, ha... You, Jin Runcandel! You bastard, will you humiliate me again? Have you forgotten our promise? Come out, I'll tear all your limbs off!"
Although it shouted like that out of anger and frustration,
All of Jin's comrades were standing in front of her.
"Huh, who's going to tear whose limbs off?"
"Zephyrin, you really dared to come here after turning Black King Mountain into that state."
"Keep your eyes wide open, and straighten your posture."
Talaris, Valkas, and Lata spoke simultaneously.
In particular, Talaris closed the distance in an instant and drove her fist into Zephyrin's jaw even before it could respond to her words.
Screech, crack-!
The sound of the fist, imbued with the power of ten thousand, colliding with the demon dragon's jaw gave everyone an undeniable feeling.
Didn't it die? That is, Zephyrin received its second shock from that punch.
"Choke!"
The shockwave and fist wind swirled like a whirlwind, and the spreading cold instantly froze Zephyrin's arms and legs, binding them like chains.
"No. Cough!"
"What do you mean, 'no'?"
"Ah! You must not know who I am, ack! Agh!"
"Heh, looks like you need to take a beating until you calm down."
Thud, thud, thud!
Without any need for the other companions to step in, Talaris dealt powerful and delightful blows to Zephilin.
After 5 minutes of relentless and merciless beating, Zephilin couldn't help but think with a swollen face, 'This... isn't right...'
Obviously, this wasn't what she had expected.
Even if she couldn't use the power of the leader (although she used it once more), Zephilin's martial prowess was not to be underestimated.
However, she was startled by Tikan's defensive equipment, hastily using the leader's power, landing on the ground somewhat exhausted, and facing formidable opponents.
Moreover, Zephilin assumed that if Jin had a conscience, he would greet her in a gentlemanly manner, especially considering the promise they made in the Sota Desert.

"Ah, I was wondering... Zephilin, it was you. If you had contacted me beforehand, I would have welcomed you courteously. I thought you were a terrorist. Oh, are you actually a terrorist? Since it's Kinzelo."
As Jin pretended not to know, Zephilin's eyes filled with purple magic and her hostility rose.
"Jin, Runcandel, you bastard!"
"No, this isn't the time to be so reckless. Acting foolishly won't do you any good, will it?"
Zephilin calmed her excitement and looked at Jin's companions.
"... Lord Jin, long time no see."
In the end, she admitted that she could get into big trouble if she continued to provoke them, especially in her current state, unlike in the old days when she had her full power.
"It's not that long, comrade of the Sota Desert. It seems you also safely escaped from that desert?"
You devil...
Barely suppressing the curses welling up in her throat, Zephilin forced a smile.
"Of course, even though I can't use my full power right now, do you think I'd have trouble with something like that?"
"It sounds like you think these guys would be nothing if you could use your full power."
"That's not what I mean. You're misunderstanding."
"I've been curious since the last time, what are you relying on to keep moving alone? Moreover, this is my base. Coming uninvited like this is unacceptable."
It wasn't that Zephilin preferred to move alone.
As a demon king, she thought it was undignified to move around with a large group... it was a matter of pride.
However, she didn't answer because it was an embarrassing situation. Dragons, demons, and other immortal-like beings tended to have such strange, old-fashioned cultures and beliefs.
"Just barely spared you because we had a promise, so I hope there won't be any more rude situations like this."
"Fine, I got it... Can you untie this now and talk?"
"I don't want to."
When Talaris flatly refused, Zephyrine replied quietly.
"Vice-Principal, there's not much to gain from joking around like this any longer. There should be records the previous vice-principals left about me…"
At that, Talaris burst into light laughter.
"Huh, it seems everyone is taking jokes seriously today. Devil Dragon Zephyrine, there is indeed a very short record left."
"It seems most of them have disappeared. There were quite a few interesting anecdotes with the Vice-Principal. Wasn't there any content saying not to be hostile with me?"
There was. The only record left about Zephyrine in the Vice-Principal's office was one line.
Avoid if encountered.
'It's not a designated target for sealing or extermination, and its power seems to be just average now. There must be a reason for such a record to remain.'
Swoosh…
The ice that bound Zephyrine scattered into the air.
"Just remember that if you threaten my son-in-law like this again, it won't end as a joke. You too, and your base."
It was common knowledge that Vice-Principal Talaris Endorma was very friendly with Jin. By now, the Hosa people thought that Jin and Syris's marriage was a confirmed matter.

However, those who knew 'the secret of the Vice-Principal' also knew that they maintained absolute neutrality. Sometimes, to solve the world's anomalies, it was necessary to join hands with any force.
'It seems that the Vice-Principal is not the same as before, hinting at deviating from neutrality while warning me…'
It was new information for Zephyrine.
"Fine, I'll keep that in mind. Anyway, Jin, keep your promise with me."
Zephyrine was quite arrogant when she came, but now she was angry and anxious.
-That's right, those items are like pearl necklaces on pigs for Runcandel. Next time, you won't be fooled like this in the negotiations. So enjoy today's small victory, Jin.
If it weren't for that cunning guy washing his mouth, this time, too, she would have been beaten up and returned without any income like a fool.
"I'll do that."
Surprisingly, Jin complied with Zephyrine's request obediently.
"Does this mean you'll hand over the blueprints and machines to us?"

"That's going too far. I'll have an official meeting with Kinzelo. At that time, I'll give you a chance to decipher the blueprints and machines. Deciphering must take place in front of both forces, and everything must be shared with our side."
"Ha! You're spewing bandit-like words again."

"Don't get me wrong, Zephyrine. I was the winner that day in the desert. The items are in my possession, so both Zipple and your Kinzelo are losers. Be grateful that I'm even offering such generosity. If you don't like it... just go back empty-handed. Leaving with your life intact wouldn't be so bad."
"All the demon tribes will curse you someday, Jin."
Jin smiled and replied.

"It's okay, I'm immune. I'll decide on the date of the meeting and notify you. It seems like we're done here, what will you do? I was having a meal, so why don't you try some dishes before you leave?"
